Official sources & verification

Where these listings come from

Read on 2026-10-30. Lists come from 10 state associations so far. Not yet listed: Delhi (DDCA), UP (UPCA) and Punjab (PCA) sites refuse scripted reads; Andhra and Assam sites load no district list; Rajasthan's 2026 district list is an unreadable PDF; Karnataka, Haryana, Jharkhand, Odisha, Vidarbha, Saurashtra, Baroda, Goa, Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand and J&K sites did not answer on 30 Oct 2026; the north-east associations, Maharashtra's districts and Hyderabad's member clubs are still to be read. Private cricket academies are not listed: no official register of them exists, and the BCCI does not accredit academies. Most district associations and clubs have no address on the source list: use the association's list or call the district office. Club lists are a club's league membership, not proof that it runs a coaching programme: ask the club about nets and junior teams.

  1. Bihar Cricket Association — Districts (opens in a new tab) 38 district cricket associations with office address and number of affiliated clubs, read 2026-10-30.
  2. Gujarat Cricket Association — Associated Districts (opens in a new tab) 10 district associations (incl. Daman) with location and address; the Dadra and Nagar Haveli page was empty.
  3. Kerala Cricket Association — District Associations (opens in a new tab) The 14 district associations; KCA lists their office bearers, not their addresses.
  4. Tamil Nadu Cricket Association — District Associations (opens in a new tab) 37 district associations, from the list file TNCA's site loads (assets/js/district-associate.json).
  5. Cricket Association of Bengal — Affiliated clubs and districts (opens in a new tab) 94 first-division clubs and 18 district units (Districts.php), read 2026-10-30. CAB's site says it is under construction; its universities and other associations lists are not used.
  6. Mumbai Cricket Association — Ordinary Maidan clubs (opens in a new tab) 211 ordinary maidan clubs (voting members). Office clubs, schools/colleges and associate members are left out: they are workplace or institution teams, not open clubs.
  7. Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association — MPCA Academy and Regional Academy (opens in a new tab) Sanjay Jagdale Cricket Academy at Holkar Stadium, Indore, and the Regional Academy camp scheme.
  8. Hyderabad Cricket Association — press release on regional coaching camps (10 Oct 2026) (opens in a new tab) Year-round camps at Karimnagar (North Telangana hub) and Mahabubnagar (South Telangana hub).
  9. Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association — website (opens in a new tab) Sub-centres at Jogindernagar (Mandi), Tissa (Chamba) and Sarash (Kullu), as named in HPCA's own photo posts.
  10. BCCI — How the BCCI Centre of Excellence is shaping India's high-performance system (opens in a new tab)
  11. MRF Tyres — 'Ace of Pace' fast-bowler hunt by the MRF Pace Foundation (opens in a new tab)
  12. Khelo India — List of Khelo India Centres (Aug 2026) (opens in a new tab) Checked for cricket: no Khelo India Centre teaches it, so none are listed here.
